The '''Pacor sector''' was located in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="New Territories" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Corthenia sector/Legends|Corthenia sector]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], the [[Barsa sector/Legends|Barsa]] and [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sectors]] [[spinward]], and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Dantus sector/Legends|Dantus sector]] Rimward. In the [[trailing]] direction, the Pacor [[Sector/Legends|sector]] shared a border with the [[Irishi sector/Legends|Irishi sector]].<ref name="Mid Rim" /> The sector retained those borders by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], by which [[Time/Legends|time]] it was situated within [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGtW" />

The Pacor sector contained the [[Traval-Pacor system/Legends|Traval-Pacor system]], which was situated at a junction of [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] connecting the Pacor to the Corthenia and Glythe sectors.<ref name="EGtW" /> By [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. [[Yansan]] is stated by ''Alliance Intelligence Reports'' to have graduated from the [[Traval-Parcor System Institute of Technology]] "about three and a half years ago," which translates to approximately [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the site of the [[Traval-Parcor System Institute of Technology]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] in the Traval-Pacor system to produce [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="EGtW" /> In 12 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], a [[Battle of the Traval-Pacor system|battle]] was fought in the system between the [[Navy/Legends|naval]] forces of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and the New Republic, in which the latter faction was victorious.<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pacor sector was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> In [[2011]], the sector was first depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://web.archive.org/web/20120117150257/https://www.starwars.com/atlas/midrim/index.html Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim]," which placed it in grid squares K-6 and K-7.<ref name="MidRimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=atlas/midrim/index.html|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref>
